title: Arkaro Insights with Mark Blackwell — 'we run rings around our conventional competitors because they can't think past the current quarter'
summary: Mark Blackwell hosts a 47-minute Arkaro Insights episode tracing Incorruptible's arc — Grundfos, Bosch, Novo Nordisk, Costco, H-E-B, Devoted Health, Mary Parker Follett's invisible leader, and what to do on Monday morning.
blockquote: We run rings around our conventional competitors because they can't think past the current quarter and we can make multi-decade investments.
